page.layout: Running head at top centre above the text. Two parallel text columns on the left printed page: left column (Vicomagistri ... Porticus Claudij) and right column (Amphitheatrum Vespasian ... Therma Traiani), with an inscription set in capitals inside the left column. Marginal line numbers (10, 20, 30, 40, 50) in the left margin of the left column. Page number top right. Signature at foot right of right column.

page.notes: Marginal line numbers 10–50 in the left margin; the left column's inscription lines are set in small capitals. Several words are uncertain in the small-capital inscriptions and in the faint left-margin numerals. Page furniture: the signature "Rrr 2" and catchword-free foot; "IVLIVS" at foot right is the printed signature word and is treated as part of the signature line.
